notes.content: [list][*][p]Improvements to how fullscreen/windowed resolutions, devices, and monitors are handled between sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to troubleshooting tools[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content: [p]We're proud to announce that [b]A World of Keflings is officially Verified for Steam Deck![/b] [/p][p]We did a lot of work to make sure the game ran well on Valve's portable device, and now we've got the checkmark to prove it. So feel free to take your kingdom on the go and help the Keflings rebuild their world anywhere, anytime.[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes for 2025.08.22
notes.content: [list][*][p]Friends of host can push things, punch things, and order potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes in fonts and text[/p][/*][*][p]Better window resize handling while editing giant[/p][/*][*][p]Support shift-click and ctrl-click for alt actions with mouse[/p][/*][*][p]More troubleshooting tools[/p][/*][/list]
